title: Does anyone have any theories on how we all have similar dreams?

classification.theory_summary: Author asks why people have similar dreamscapes; proposes astral travel/out-of-body travel to shared planes with multiverse-like variations.
classification.skip_reason: No concrete dream narrative, locations, sensory details, or events described; primarily a theory/question about shared dreamscapes.

meta.author_theory: We leave our body when we sleep; author claims ability to astral travel (mind awake while body asleep). Similar dreamscapes are shared places/planes visited during out-of-body travel; multiverse accounts for variations from mostly identical to partly identical.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains general claims about dreamscapes/astral travel but no describable dream locations, sensory qualities (light, cleanliness, crowding), entities, movements, boundaries, or interactions to extract.
